facts.claim: Most apps convert 1% to 2% of installs into a purchase, with retail at 1.38% and travel at 2.41%
facts.excerpt: Most mobile apps see install-to-purchase conversion between 1% and 2%. Retail apps 1.38%; travel apps 2.41%.

facts.claim: A good conversion rate for an e-commerce mobile app sits around 2% to 6% depending on order value and purchase frequency
facts.excerpt: A good conversion rate for an ecommerce mobile app sits around 2% to 6%, depending on industry, average order value, product type and purchase frequency.

facts.claim: Across more than 145,000 installs the median time from install to first revenue is about 48 hours, with the 90th percentile near 14 days
facts.source_title: Install-to-first-revenue timing: mobile app payback windows in 2026
facts.excerpt: Median time from install to first revenue is approximately 48 hours across over 145,000 installs; the 90th percentile stretched to roughly 14 days.

facts.claim: About half of users who ever pay do so within two days of installing, and 90% within two weeks
facts.source_title: Install-to-first-revenue timing: mobile app payback windows in 2026
facts.excerpt: Roughly half of revenue-converting users do so within two days of install, and 90% convert within two weeks.

facts.claim: AI apps earn 41% more revenue per payer and churn about 30% faster
facts.excerpt: AI-powered apps generate 41% more revenue per payer, but they churn 30% faster.

facts.claim: India's app revenue passed 300 million dollars in the first quarter of 2026, up 33%, on 6.2 billion downloads with non-gaming apps at 72%
facts.excerpt: In Q1 2026 India's mobile app market revenue surpassed $300M, up 33% year-over-year, on 6.2 billion downloads, non-gaming apps at 72%.
